newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes close out slightly weaker, sours firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes close out slightly weaker, sours firm.

text.p: U.S. crudes closed out weaker Wednesday in line with spot NYMEX losses fueled by heating oil declines ahead of the American Petroleum Institute (API) stock report, traders said.

Cash markets featured a strong sour grade trade, where numerous reasons -- including unconfirmed talk of production problems offshore Louisiana -- were cited for narrowing differentials for West Texas Sour and Eugene Island values.
January West Texas Intermediate/Cushing ended the session down around 5 cents at $25.65-75 a barrel. Jan/Feb WTI spreads widened to around 70 cts, kicking Postings Plus values higher.
